messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a small but consistent p99 regression on the west cluster after the autotune change yesterday. Baseline qps unchanged but tail latency up ~18% for short-seq traffic.

dan: Saw that too. Repro locally with synthetic short sequences + KV colds. Seems tied to kernel selector preferring the fused path more often.

sk: Can you paste the profile?

maria: Paste below — short run with 4 warmups then stress: ```
# short sequence profile
seq=8, batch=16
selector: fused_fast_path (chosen 72% of calls)
launch_overhead_ms: 0.9 -> 1.6 (median -> p99)
kv_miss_rate: 23%\n```

dryan: I mean ryan: selector choosing fused path increases kernel hot-starts when KV misses force cache refills. The fused kernel has slightly higher per-launch handshake. With continuous batching we amplify launches.

ash: (typo) ash: Experiment: force old.hybrid path for seq<=16 and replay.

ash: Results: p99 drops back to expected, throughput similar. So it's a selector-induced regression not hardware.

maria: Good. Hypothesis: autotuner’s cost model weights per-token exec time but underestimates launch handshake when KV cache is cold or when batch arrival is bursty.

sk: We should add a launch_penalty term to the cost function, dependent on recent launch rate and observed kv_miss_rate. Quick patch idea: cost += lambda * launch_penalty(ms) where launch_penalty = max(0, p99_launch - median_launch).

ryan: Sounds reasonable. Also consider hysteresis: avoid flipping path for a single spike. Maybe require at least 10s window and min sample count.

maria: Agreed. I'll prototype the penalty and hysteresis and run a replay across our 24h short-seq trace.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline started for maria/autotune/launch-penalty (staging).

dan: For telemetry: add new tag selector.reason and include launch_ms and kv_miss flags so we can attribute tail events.

ash: Also log continuous_batch_window size per scheduling decision — I think small windows + high burstiness are the combinator that exposes this.

maria: On it. If the staged replay looks good I'll roll to canary overnight. If not, revert selector change and keep hybrid as default.

ryan: Thx. If anyone sees >10% tail regression post-deploy ping #oncall and add a note here.

sk: One more: add a unit test that simulates kv_miss spikes and asserts selector keeps p99 within X% of baseline. Prevent regressions in CI.

maria: Added to TODOs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
